tweet.text: A serving benchmark that ignores queueing is mostly measuring a demo. On one L4 running Qwen2.5 7B, 72 ms beat 120 ms at one request. At 32 concurrent requests, the reported results were 639 ms and 258 ms. This still says nothing about mixed prompt lengths, tool calls, or long outputs.
